about: Every compiled answer of the two untrained dev rows (local-qwen2.5-coder-1.5b-instruct-0shot and -3shot) that the picture review of 27 Nov described, with the review's verdict and the measurements right_part reads, copied from the saved records. 'right': the part asked for (for an edit, shape and sliders both right). 'near miss': the right body with a small feature the review said was wrong (corner style). 'wrong': anything else. Answers that did not compile are left out: they fail right_part whatever the threshold. The measurements were copied again after both rows were rescored on 28 Nov (stated sizes read from the named sizes, shapes compared at $fn = 48, the voxel grid offset in z); no verdict changed.
